name: Bauernhof Lieferthof
beschreibung: The farm Bauernhof Lieferthof in Bad Häring is a family-run inn with an adjoining working farm. The accommodation features guest rooms decorated in traditional Tyrolean style and a welcoming dining lounge serving regional cuisine. Dishes are lovingly prepared using fresh farm-grown ingredients. Located on the peaceful edge of Bad Häring, it provides easy access to both scenic outdoor nature hikes and the village center. Guests can tour the farm and witness authentic daily agricultural work. The inn is an ideal starting base for exploring the surrounding alpine scenery of the Tyrolean Unterland.
